shots.detail_en: Deep-night war room; wall covered with hand-drawn K-line charts and crisscrossing red wool threads; an old TV glows with static snow
shots.sub: 电视里熊天成（画外）：「十年最大的熊市，明早开演。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: TV screen close-up: Xiong Tiancheng sits upright in a black suit and red tie, white temples, smiling with compassion
shots.sub: 熊天成：「不是我要熊——是贪婪的人，该还账了。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Mancang, Hongli and Changhong stand around the TV, three faces lit by screen glow
shots.sub: 满仓（喃喃）：「他上电视了……全城都听见了。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut street: retail investor A hugs a bankbook pacing outside the brokerage door, knuckles creasing the cover
shots.sub: 散户甲：「明早……是跑还是不跑……」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut street corner under arcade buildings: investor B waves his arms at a small circle of neighbors, alarmed
shots.sub: 散户乙：「熊爷上电视了！熊爷说的，还能有假？」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut: a dark apartment block with a single window glowing with TV light
Back in the war room: Hongli nails the last batch of ledger pages onto the wall, hammer loud in the night
shots.sub: 红利：「联华网络……还在翻倍。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up of ledger figures: columns of numbers growing as blurred afterimages, no final figure shown
shots.sub: 红利（画外）：「没有终点数——他在等我们乱。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Mancang squats on the floor counting a small stack of pager samples, wiping each one
shots.sub: 满仓：「就这几台样品，不够，差得远——」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Mancang looks up with shining eyes, gripping one pager, rising to his feet
shots.sub: 满仓：「明晚，全厅的BP机——我全租！全租！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli adds one line to the ledger page without looking up
shots.sub: 红利：「账上先记一笔：信号塔，一座。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Changhong says nothing, opening his father's hand-drawn K-line notebook
shots.sub: 长虹（低）：「爸，第三战，开在明早。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Slow close-up: the missing last line on the notebook's final page; Changhong's thumb strokes the blank row
Close-up: Changhong closes the notebook and slides it into the inner pocket of his white shirt, fastening the collar
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut montage of three getting into position: Hongli checks pages and coils red thread / Mancang stacks pager samples square / Changhong verifies each hand-drawn line on the wall
shots.sub: 旁白：「开演前夜，蚂蚁各就各位。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Mancang suddenly uneasy again, rubbing the pager samples in his hands
shots.sub: 满仓：「要真开打……我心里还是突突的。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Changhong lays a hand on Mancang's shoulder, glancing toward Hongli
shots.sub: 长虹：「怕不丢人。怕还站着，才叫同盟。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Mancang grins and nods hard; Hongli presses her lips and nods too
Medium shot: before turning off the light, Changhong takes one last look at the full wall of hand-drawn lines and whispers to it
shots.sub: 长虹：「熊爷的福音吓人——可蚂蚁听不见福音。蚂蚁只听得见彼此。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Wide shot in darkness: lights out, only TV glow leaking through the door seam, three silhouettes standing before the wall
Close-up: TV light through the door seam flickers across the wall, Xiong Tiancheng's face flashing in the glow
shots.sub: 电视里熊天成（画外）：「明早……开演。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
